how: Calls recruit hands for the flag and later return them to defence.
Participants propose emblems, convert Dutch colours with a crest and redesign a flag judged too easy to devastate.
Participants report a flag started by chat users and distinguish completed building from remaining upkeep.
Coordinates locate the flag and a reply tells a would-be corrector to follow the template carefully.
Participants repair the flag, call for constant camping and prioritise existing pictures over checkerboard growth.
Retain observed maintenance without assuming that uninformed keepers erased an agreed change or abandoned it because notification failed.
Flag makers disown Hulk destroyers while other speakers attribute damage to rogue users and expansionists.
Members demand that expanders leave Hulk alone and return neighbouring space under an agreement.
Neighbours negotiate a three-pixel move, overlap and Hulk relocation, while participants later invoke a GreenLattice agreement.
Some members propose converting another flag, attacking Serbia and extending the checkerboard across neighbours.
The injured neighbour relocates Hulk with local assistance, rather than Croatia relocating its own flag after defeat.
Success posts celebrate finished appearances while replies credit labour and warn that an intact flag can be fleeting.
Members share a timelapse and final state, mourn the ending and describe the flag's fate.
A member proposes another canvas after closure and receives a refusal, not an adopted continuation plan.
Treat five alternate accounts as an accusation, not verified machine capacity or an admitted upkeep workaround.
A rebuilding request receives a bare commitment to help.
April greetings and explicit distrust key the date as joking without establishing a fake canvas takeover.
One participant judges the room too small to beat the void and another answers with an accusation of internal enemies.

why: A single room cannot test the comparative frequency claim, and the moderator cool-off's missing trigger prevents classifying it as canvas governance.

how: A starter proposes a flag and maps a possible beginning without making later recruits part of the role.
A participant carries the neighbour's three-pixel relocation proposal back into the exchange.
Croatian helpers promise pixels and a requester reports seeing help, completion and restored faith.
A participant reports making a heart with Bulgarians, evidencing a joint mark but not a standing defensive coalition.
A post taunts Serbia's poor canvas fortunes without demonstrating victory or the cause of its difficulties.

why: National targets and historical jokes do not establish a specific quarrel carried into this canvas from before it.

how: Members want canvas filtering, welcome unrelated posts and complain about tiresome expansion calls without establishing a moderator posting rule.
Participants translate canvas disputes into national historical analogies and familiar local quotations.

why: Negotiated overlap and relocation do not show an enduring host jurisdiction or a guest application system.
The attack proposals name a national target but do not explicitly name a prior tie or historical episode as the reason for attacking it.

how: A sign proposer answers a complaint by stating that nobody controls every Redditor, directly fitting the revised limits-of-commitment range.
A reply to a cleaned-canvas post identifies wrong pixels, correcting its claimed clean appearance without proving further editing or a preservation dispute.
Members invite coordination through Discord and IRC while a participant declines Discord and proposes a design change publicly.
Questions about the canvas, timer and pictures receive explanations both during placing and after closure.

why: Repair visitors are visible but no cited visitor describes discovery through the mark, renewed membership or incorporation into the room's ordinary activity.

how: Participants make canvas-specific jokes about electronic vandals, excessive time, repeated quotations and retrospective disgrace.
Participants suggest starting coordinates, switch toward an existing flag and propose moving the crest before any documented loss of that design.

why: Invitations into coordination venues and a pointer to another subreddit do not show the creation of a new canvas-born room.
Provocative symbols, a rebuke for going too far and a moderator cool-off lack enough context to establish a dispute specifically over offensive speech or symbols.
A report of appearance on another canvas-related subreddit and a politician's depicted help do not establish outreach to creators, staff or press.

how: Members condemn defiling another flag and ruining neighbouring work for extra pixels, later describing the reputational cost of making outsiders beg.
An internal accusation receives a rebuke, admission of excess, goodwill work and explicit reconciliation.

why: Public war announcements and warnings to targets do not establish covert planning, spying, linguistic concealment or infiltration.
Filtering complaints and a separate speaker's sabotage admission do not establish that objection to canvas posts motivated damaging the room's mark.

how: Members report an overnight drawing effort, promise spare-time clicks and describe spending hours on the flag.
A missing-toolbar report receives an explanation that placement ended, showing experienced site limits rather than a verified glitch or successful technical fix.

why: A Serbian flair and neighbouring-picture maintenance are not explicit statements of dual belonging or divided allegiance.

how: A flag-help call leads through location discussion to a promise of spare-time clicks, demonstrating recruitment without measuring unseen placements.
A proposal to make the flag supplies the object and coordinates around which the same post calls for hands.
The new-flag post is followed by its author's instruction that it now only needs maintaining.
Negotiation also follows damage inflicted on neighbours by local expansion, not only neighbours eroding the room's own mark.
A speaker explicitly invokes the GreenLattice agreement as the reason to return occupied space, without demonstrating compliance.

why: The alternate-account allegation does not connect upkeep shortages to adopting extra accounts or scripts.

how: A neighbour's report of successful relocation receives an immediate celebration of the shared achievement.
A success post occasions a reply presenting a compressed record of the work, showing a local celebration-to-record sequence.

why: Final-state records precede a replacement-canvas call but no passage makes the record the reason or resource for continuing.
The judgment of insufficient hands elicits disagreement rather than a demonstrated move; the documented relocation concerns the injured neighbour.
A template instruction is visible but no quoted exchange shows its posting settling an argued design.

how: A rebuilding call receives a bare acceptance that asks nothing back.
Declining can also be bare, so reason-giving is not a necessary condition of a written refusal.
Help can be requested by the injured neighbour and supplied as restitution without the helping room first running short of hands.
Negotiated placement leads to a rebuilding report and a promise to help through the same reply chain.

why: An attack suggestion occurs under a recruitment post, but no speaker says the call brought them to the canvas or redirected their labour.

how: A direct answer rejects attacking Serbia in favour of making something together, while another recruited respondent answers with an insult.
A neighbour's complaint about destruction can open treaty-making without a visible initiating attack call.
The attack proposer answers a challenge by reporting a war declaration in the target's subreddit, carrying the proposed contest into talk.

why: The reported joint heart does not show upkeep pressure creating a coalition or reciprocal defence.

how: An expansion call receives a complaint that such posts have become tiresome, supporting the member-objection end rather than a moderator restriction.

why: The control disclaimer answers a complaint before the recorded author-approved relocation; an invoked earlier pact does not establish the disclaimer's post-agreement trigger.

statement: Issuing a moderator cool-off with an unavailable trigger
how: Retain the moderator's three-day cool-off as a local act without turning its missing parent into evidence of canvas governance or hate-speech policing.

statement: Redirecting an event thread to an unrelated subreddit
how: Retain the unrelated redirect as beside-work talk without assigning it an organizing function or assuming it is an established in-joke.
